Definition: to rush upon; by implication, to toss (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to storm, rage; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to storm; 1a2) stormy, growing storm (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be enraged; 1c) (Piel) to storm away; 1d) (Pual) to be driven by storm
